title: Estrogen modulates reward prediction errors and reinforcement learning
primary_outputs: Estrous-stage and hormone associations with trial-resolved dopamine reward responses.
Relations between fitted reward prediction errors, reward history and dopamine encoding across rats.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: Official EstrousRPEPaper README links three Zenodo records. Figure2 Pstruct/Bstruct also needs SerumTable fromFigure1; Figure3 loads RawData_Figure3.mat. Some behavioral parameters are supplied BestFits.
lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_inspection_level: Saved metadata, author documentation and selected source inspection; this audit did not newly read payloads.

versions_and_loader_contract.input_code_bridge: The official README maps multiple Zenodo archives, not just Figure2. Source ProcessData_Figure2 loads Pstruct/Bstruct and requires SerumTable from RawData_Figure1; both archives are identified. Figure3 archive directory contains RawData_Figure3.mat; its loader reads ratTrial, Pstruct/Bstruct, times_resampled and stage labels. Full raw trial/photometry structures are documented, not only rendered panels.

comparability: Stage is not randomized. RPE-gain and reuptake explanations need matched models and known photometry preprocessing, and complete cross-archive rat/session joins.
Paper+data versus +official-code arms still need one identical empirical task, matched noncode resources/budgets, separate source exposure, and preserved reproduction→improvement stages.

task_specific_gates: Use rat/session hierarchy and hormone measurements; cycle stage is not a randomized intervention.
